raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a donut chart displaying a hierarchical breakdown of character types. At the center is a large blue circle labeled "Virtual Characters," which is further subdivided into seven segments radiating outward: "Comic Characters," "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," "Game Characters," and "Custom Characters." Surrounding this central circle is an outer ring, also labeled "Virtual Characters," which contains a green segment labeled "Real Characters," which is further divided into seven smaller segments: "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers." The chart uses distinct colors for each segment, with blue for the Virtual Characters category and green for the Real Characters category. The "Custom Characters" segment is colored pink, while the segments under "Real Characters" are various shades of green. All segments are labeled with text. There is no legend or percentage indicators visible within the chart. The segments are arranged in a circular fashion around the central blue circle, with no apparent ordering by size or other criteria.
raw_responses.English: This is a donut chart illustrating the breakdown of character types into two main categories: “Virtual Characters” and “Real Characters.” The outer ring, which is divided into multiple slices, represents “Virtual Characters,” including “Comic Characters,” “Movie Characters,” “Teleplay Characters,” “Novel Characters,” and “Game Characters,” all rendered in a light blue color. The inner circle, which is a solid light blue, is labeled “Virtual Characters” and appears to represent the total or a major component. The “Real Characters” category, shown as a green segment in the center, is further subdivided into “Custom Characters” (a pink segment) and several smaller green segments labeled “Scientists,” “Artists,” “Athletes,” “Writers,” “Musicians,” “Actors,” and “Influencers.” The chart does not include percentage labels inside the slices or a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized (e.g., exploded or bolded). The segments appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order of size from left to right, with “Comic Characters” being the largest slice in the outer ring. The overall structure suggests a hierarchical or nested breakdown, with “Virtual Characters” forming the outer layer and “Real Characters” forming the inner layer.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Diagramm ist ein ringförmiges Kreisdiagramm, das zwei Hauptkategorien, „Virtual Characters“ und „Real Characters“, in einem konzentrischen Layout darstellt; „Virtual Characters“ nimmt den größten äußeren Ring ein und ist in sechs Unterkategorien unterteilt – „Comic Characters“, „Movie Characters“, „Teleplay Characters“, „Novel Characters“, „Game Characters“ und „Custom Characters“ – wobei „Custom Characters“ als kleinerer innerer Ring dargestellt ist und „Real Characters“ als weiterer kleinerer innerer Ring mit sechs Unterkategorien – „Scientists“, „Artists“, „Athletes“, „Writers“, „Musicians“, „Actors“ und „Influencers“ – angezeigt wird; die Segmente sind farblich unterschiedlich kodiert, wobei „Virtual Characters“ in Blau, „Real Characters“ in Grün und „Custom Characters“ in Rosa dargestellt sind; die Prozentangaben sind nicht explizit angegeben, aber die Größe der Segmente deutet auf unterschiedliche Anteile hin; das Diagramm enthält eine Legende, die die Zuordnung der Farben zu den Kategorien erklärt, und die Segmente sind nach Größe in absteigender Reihenfolge angeordnet, wobei die größten Segmente außen liegen und die kleinsten innen.
